thread:
anya: Heads up — seeing a ~2x tail latency spike on /v1/generate around 12:10 UTC, throughput dropped ~40%. Autoscaler didn't add capacity fast enough. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/requests?svc=runtime-us-east-1

jordan: I can see it. p95 jumped to ~620ms, p50 ~180ms. Queue length spiked from 30->120. warm_cohort shows zero new warms allocated for ~3m.

infra-bot: [ALERT] provision_timeout: pool=worker-us-east-1 region=us-east-1 timeout=120s action=scaleup_failed

mike: Quick profiler pass: kernel selection flipped at ~12:09 from optimized tiled_matmul_v2 -> matmul_sm_legacy for a subset of shards. Kernel-score noise ramped up, see snippet: ```kernel_scores: [0.82,0.79,0.31,0.28] -> choose idx 3 fallback; decision_ts=1700000009``` Batching heuristic also oscillating — small micro-batches (~1-3 requests) instead of target 8-12.

samira: KV cache hitrate dropped hard at same time: 78% -> 21% across the cohort. Eviction rate spiked. suspect eviction storm or mem leak on a host -> more KV misses = more KV-fetch stalls.

jordan: Node metrics show one pod with GPU mem at 98% and sustained memcpy bursts. I see GPU PCIe traffic spikes and CPU steal on that node — noisy neighbor likely.

anya: Putting pieces together: traffic pattern changed (many short requests), batching window contracted -> lower batch sizes. Kernel selector got noisy because perf signals were sparse -> fallback kernels used. Simultaneously a KV eviction storm reduced cache hits which amplified per-request work. Autoscaler saw short-lived queue blips and adhered to cooldown -> provisioning lag. Net effect looked like coldstart behavior but was systemic.

mike: Short-term mitigations: 1) enforce a minimum batching window (force batch target 6) for this route, 2) temporarily pin kernel family to stable tiled_matmul_v2 for that model group, 3) mark the noisy pod for cordon/restart. Will open PR for the batching guard.

opsbot: applied: warm_cohort_target(us-east-1)=5->8 by request of @mike (temporary). change_id=chg-4821.

samira: I'll gather KV eviction traces and heap stats (kv-evict-trace, lru-stats, mem-allocs) and correlate with pod restarts. Uploading trace tarball to /s3/perf/traces/1999000001-kv.tar.gz and linking to incident doc.

jordan: I've scheduled a short autoscaler policy tweak: reduce scaleup cooldown from 120s -> 45s for bursty routes and add a queue-smoothing window so transient spikes don't get ignored. Will roll in canary to us-east-1.

anya: Owners: Samira -> KV traces & eviction remediation; Mike -> batching/kernel quick-fix + PR; Jordan -> autoscaler policy canary & noisy-node remediation. Re-check in 20m. If anyone sees recurrence ping here. :thumbsup:

mike: note for postmortem: add kernel-score stability metric and kv-hitrate trend aligned with batch-size histogram. Want automated alert if kernel flips >2x in 5m.

samira: ack. starting collection now.
